exposure: planned electric vehicle presence overlap Measurement / 1440; include blocked entrants
completion_time: actual completion minus intent creation, completed intents only
waiting: sum unique physical queue intervals per intent with >=1 arrival; observed censored intervals retained
queue_pressure: max Measurement+Drain E_wait/(E_wait+6*P_eff); P_eff=all physical backlog battery energy / frozen-state FIFO clearing hours; busy ports and noncohort workload included
censoring: unresolved retains observed intervals and energy; incomplete required Drain invalidates fitness
unmet_energy_time: completion for completed intents, observation end for incomplete intents
taper: piecewise constant acceptance multiplier; default flat
power_allocation: port/EV capped, station total power proportional scaling; reallocate at completion/taper boundary
mobility_cohort: planned activity scheduled in Measurement; observe through Drain; taxi existing shift rules
stranded_cohort: EVs with planned Measurement presence, stranding observed from episode start through Drain
